fire: The prize was awarded again in 1960, this time to a chemist.

quiet: The prize was awarded in 1960 to a chemist at Yale.
Three surveys were conducted in rural villages.
The family had six children and lived abroad.

The rebels attacked from the north this time.
They sampled many rivers and found high levels of lead.

Two bridges cross the river, and trains use them.
